svg.title: Ultima humanoid rig
svg.desc: Neutral pose of the default 1.75 metre player. Front and side projections show parent connections and primary pivots. Violet guides show illustrative spine, femur and clavicle curves. Insets show the clavicles from above, and every finger and toe on the right side.
svg.text: Neutral pose · default 1.75 m player · 73 joint pivots plus the actor root
Z / Y projection · left and right overlap

g.aria-label: S-curves of the clavicles seen from above

svg.text: Pelvis and upper-body pivots coincide at Y = 0.77 m. Detail views separate joints that overlap in the full projections.
